title: A Tutorial on Quantum Amplitude Embedding with Data Re-Uploading
abstract: arXiv:2610.17836v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Amplitude embedding lets a variational quantum model read many classical features with few qubits, but the model output is then only a quadratic form in the normalized input. Data re-uploading, which encodes the input repeatedly between trainable blocks, can be used to enrich such a model. Because every additional upload of an amplitude embedding repeats a costly state preparation, the gain that an upload buys has to be known before the gates are spent. This tutorial thus addresses the problem of explaining what data re-uploading adds to an amplitude-embedded model and how large the gain is. We express sequential re-uploading and parallel re-uploading with two copies in one notation and show that each upload raises the reachable polynomial order by two. Under one trainable circuit family and one budget of trainable parameters, simulation results show that re-uploading raises the test coefficient of determination from 0.689 to between 0

translated_title: 量子振幅嵌入与数据重上传教程
translated_abstract: 振幅嵌入使变分量子模型能够用少量量子比特读取大量经典特征，但此时模型输出只是归一化输入的二次型。数据重上传（即在可训练模块之间反复编码输入）可用于丰富此类模型。由于每次额外的振幅嵌入上传都会重复一次代价高昂的量子态制备，因此在消耗量子门资源之前，必须先了解每次上传所能带来的收益。因此，本教程旨在解释数据重上传为振幅嵌入模型增加了什么，以及收益有多大。我们用统一的记号表达了顺序重上传和使用两个副本的并行重上传，并证明每次上传可将模型可达的多项式阶数提高二阶。在单一可训练电路族和相同可训练参数预算下，仿真结果表明重上传将测试决定系数（R²）从0.689提升至0.…（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 本教程统一刻画了顺序与并行数据重上传对振幅嵌入变分量子模型的增强作用，证明每次重上传可将模型可达的多项式阶数提升二阶，并在相同参数预算下显著提高了回归性能。
en_tdlr: This tutorial unifies sequential and parallel data re-uploading for amplitude-embedded variational quantum models, showing that each upload raises the reachable polynomial order by two and significantly improves regression performance under the same parameter budget.
